title: Google Pub/Sub connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Pub/Sub connector instance's settings, read by the native cloud family (`loams_connector_cloud::pubsub`, CN2 Task 19, over the REST API): the project, the subscription the source pulls and the topic the sink publishes to. `auth.credentials_json` holds the **name** of a secret (D189) and is exactly the manifest's `secrets` list. See docs/guides/connectors/google-pub-sub.md.

subscription.description: Source: the subscription pulled (required for the source).

topic.description: Sink: the topic published to (required for the sink).

endpoint.description: The API base URL, such as the emulator's http://pubsub:8085. Without `auth` an endpoint is required: the emulator takes no credentials.

credentials_json.description: The name of the secret holding a service-account key file (JSON); the connector signs an RS256 JWT with it and exchanges it at the key's token_uri. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

ack_deadline_seconds.description: The ack deadline; it is extended at half this while an event waits for the Fabric.

receivers.description: Pull loops run in parallel on the subscription.

ordering_key.description: Sink: `subject` makes each message's ordering key the event's subject.
